Name: Starbucks Corporation
Description: Starbucks Corporation (SBUX) is a leading American multinational coffeehouse chain headquartered in Seattle, Washington, and is recognized as the largest coffeehouse brand globally. As a key player in the second wave of coffee culture, Starbucks not only serves high-quality coffee but also offers a unique customer experience through its innovative store designs and extensive beverage menu. With a robust international presence, the company continues to expand its footprint while emphasizing sustainability and ethical sourcing practices, which resonate with today's socially conscious consumers. Starbucks is well-positioned to capitalize on the growing demand for premium coffee and beverage offerings worldwide.
